findings.summary: Merge doesn't verify customer_id is unique in segments, so duplicate segment rows duplicate orders and inflate revenue.

judge.reason: Duplicate segment rows per customer duplicating orders and inflating revenue is the same join-fanout defect, though it doesn't mention month.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: how="inner" silently drops orders from customers with no segment, so segment totals don't sum to total revenue.

judge.reason: Matches the known inner-join dropping issue.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: groupby drops rows with NaN segment by default, so orders with null segments are lost unless dropna=False or nulls are filled.

judge.reason: Matches the known groupby NaN-dropping issue.

findings.label: valid_other
